description: Scaffold the full project structure with all dependencies, configs, entry points, types, mock data, and the Express+Vite server. This sets up the complete foundation so that UI components can be built on top.
steps: Create package.json with all required dependencies: react, react-dom, @types/react, @types/react-dom, typescript, vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, tailwindcss (v4), postcss, autoprefixer, lucide-react, motion (for motion/react), @google/genai, express, @types/express, tsx, esbuild, @tailwindcss/vite. Scripts: dev (tsx server.ts), build (vite build), lint (tsc --noEmit).
Create tsconfig.json with strict TypeScript config for React JSX.
Create vite.config.ts with React plugin and Tailwind CSS v4 plugin.
Create index.html with proper meta tags, Noto Sans Devanagari + Inter font imports from Google Fonts, and root div.
Create .env.example with placeholder keys: GEMINI_API_KEY, SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, WHATSAPP_API_TOKEN, PORT=3000.
Create src/main.tsx as React entry point mounting App.
Create src/App.tsx as main layout shell with tab-based routing placeholder (imports all components but renders a simple loading state for now).
Create src/types/index.ts with full TypeScript interfaces: Student, Staff, HostelRoom, HostelBed, MessRecord, WhatsAppLog, MealType, StudentStatus, Role, CasteCategory, Standard.

Create src/data/mockData.ts with pre-seeded data: 520 students across Std 1-12 with realistic Marathi names, tribal sub-caste tags (Katkari, Thakar, Mahadev Koli, Gond), Aadhaar verification status, application numbers. Also 38-45 staff members (Principal, 22 Teachers, 2 Clerks, 3 Hostel Rectors, 6 Support/Mess). Hostel rooms with 520 beds across Boys Wings A&B and Girls Wings A&B. Mess records. WhatsApp logs.
Create src/data/prdData.ts with system PRD documentation strings (school name, capacity, modules description) for the PrdViewer.

Create server.ts with Express backend: serves Vite in dev mode (using vite.createServer middleware), API endpoints stubs for /api/students, /api/staff, /api/ai-chat (Gemini proxy), static file serving in production. Port from env or 3000.
Create src/index.css with Tailwind v4 directives (@import 'tailwindcss') and custom CSS variables for the color palette (slate navy #1e293b, gold #d4af37, emerald #059669).
Run npm install and npm run lint to verify zero errors.
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint (tsc --noEmit) passes with no type errors
npm run dev starts the server and serves the app on port 3000
All type definitions cover Student, Staff, HostelRoom, MessRecord, WhatsAppLog
Mock data contains 520 students with Marathi names and tribal tags
.env.example exists with placeholder variable names only (no real keys)
verification: Run npm install and confirm exit code 0
Run npm run lint and confirm exit code 0
Run timeout 10 npm run dev and confirm 'server' or 'listening' appears in output
